title: Evaluation-transpose Hom law for tensor-compatible reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D and an arbitrary FamilyCore C [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. Assume its comparison obeys the tensor compatibility equation of Family for every pair of common-stage objects. Then it obeys the Hom compatibility equation of Family for every permitted internal-Hom pair: comparison at the Hom object, realized Hom map, the ambient evaluation-defined pullHom, and transport by the comparison at both inputs equal realized podCommonHomComparison followed by the realized Hom map at the pulled-back pair. No integral normalization, identity/composition law or new comparison data is asserted.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; arbitrary scheme-isomorphism reindexing, including semilinear Frobenius; old step 12; HRS: literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf; precise map normalization is the agent-written argument retained in report.md.

proof.text: Prove the abstract hom_square calculation for two ambient closed structures and an inverse-image functor with its tensor natural isomorphism. Uncurrying a transported internal-Hom arrow is tensoring the two input arrows and then uncurrying, followed by the output arrow. This follows from the adjunction counit naturality and the closed structure evaluation_naturality. Conjugate the tensor square by the comparison isomorphisms, apply inverse tensorator naturality, and combine with the evaluation square. Injectivity of the target transpose proves the abstract square. The private Lean helpers prove this calculation completely.

For the given permitted pair P, set H = RHom(P), M = P.1 and N = P.2, and let Q be its recorded pulled-back pair. The inverse transpose of the source realized Hom comparison is the source tensorator followed by realized evaluation, by SpaceData.hom.evaluation. The inverse transpose of realized podCommonHomComparison followed by the target realized Hom comparison is the target tensorator followed by realization of the inverse common tensor comparison and pulled-back evaluation. Prove this using tensorator naturality, the target SpaceData.hom.evaluation, and podCommonHomComparison_laws.evaluation. No new perfectness condition on M is used.

Postcompose the given tensor compatibility equation at (H,M) by the realized inverse common tensor comparison and cancel its isomorphism. Naturality of C.comparison at the source evaluation is the required evaluation square. Apply the proved abstract hom_square, with the ambient pullHom unfolded as its defining transpose. This yields the original Hom equation with exactly the recorded pair transport and comparison components.

proof_origin.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; Stacks 0GMX. H2 formalizes the existing agent-written evaluation-transpose argument using closed adjunction naturality, the supplied HomLaws and the common-stage evaluation law; not claimed verbatim in BS.

theorem normalized_reindexing_hom
    (C : FamilyCore l D)
    (h_tensor_compatibility : ∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
          (M N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map ((C.data U).tensor.tensor.hom.app (M,
          N)) ≫
          (C.comparison T U g).inv.app ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).obj
            (M, N)) ≫
          (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
            (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom M N).hom =
        (C.pullTensor T U g).tensor.hom.app
            ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj M,
             (ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj N) ≫
          (C.data T).tensor.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
            ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app M) ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app N)) ≫
          (C.data T).tensor.tensor.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj
            M,
            (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N)) :
    ∀ (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
      (P : (commonStageHomPairs l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).FullSubcategory),
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (C.comparison T U g).hom.app
        ((commonStageDerivedInternalHom l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).obj P) ≫
      (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map
        (homComparison l U.base.left (C.data U).realization (C.data U).tensor P) ≫
      pullHom l T.base.left g.hom (C.pullTensor T U g)
        ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj P.obj.1.unop)
        ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj P.obj.2) ≫
      (ambientHom l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((C.comparison T U g).hom.app P.obj.1.unop).op
          ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app P.obj.2)) =
    (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (podCommonHomComparison l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom P) ≫
      homComparison l T.base.left (C.data T).realization (C.data T).tensor
        ((podPairPullback (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom)
      (commonStageHomPairs l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left)
      (commonStageHomPairs l (PadicAlgCl l) T.base.left)
      (podCommonPairs_pullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom)).obj P)
